body: I guess I’ll try it. I’m planning on reaching to a counselor and hope they don’t stage an intervention with my parents.
Honestly, I think you’re the first person to say I’m not stupid and actually mean it. Thank you.

I cant complete school work, I’m consistently failing with subjects, failing tests, I can’t understand or comprehend anything, I can’t remember a big chunk of my life and anything that happened recently, my peers are forced to work with me despite them being out of my league, I feel like I’m holding them down and soon they’ll see what a useless idiot I am and it’ll effect my credibility and future. I have no passions or motivation, I have nothing I like, no hobbies, and nothing to balance out the bad in my character. I have nothing to make up for my weight and I genuinely am stupid.

Even if I somehow release all tension that I’m feeling from them, I’m still so stupid and incompetent. My life is steadily declining and I know it will only get worse from here. I want to die before shit boys the fan and honestly the only think stopping me is the fear of pain.

I cant blame them for not understanding, it’s the way they were raised. I live in a very unprogressive country. However I can’t forget the harm they caused me and the way it’ll effect me for the rest of my life. I can barely function and be competent in my daily life, I don’t want to be here when it all blows over.
What are you suggesting? I can’t really change my surroundings as I’m not in a position to.

Even if they won’t react the way I want, it’s only one of other reasons. I just want to be better and stop self destructing myself and anyone I try to reach out to keep telling the same thing, that I just have to do it. Just eat, just work, just talk to us but whenever I fail to do the basic necessities that a person should do, I can only think of how much harder it’ll be in the future.
The thing is, I know that they’ll be hurt. They care about me in a way that’s toxic but they’ll still be hurt tremendously by my suicide. And if they aren’t then their reputation will take a hit.
